displayPattern: Dual 7-segment display on a Rheem R96V / (-)96V furnace (installation instructions 92-24161-124-03): d4
meaning: No valid model data on the memory card. This is a non-critical fault. The furnace should still operate, and d4 is displayed in standby.
causes: Memory card is blank, missing, or corrupt and cannot be read
A valid copy of the model data is still stored in the furnace control microprocessor
diySteps: If the furnace is heating or cooling and the display shows d4 only while it is idle, that matches the manual: operation should proceed as normal
Technician: replace the card with the original card or the correct replacement. The manual says never to use a card from another furnace, condenser, or air handler
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician to replace a corrupt or missing card. d4 does not by itself shut the furnace down. d1 does.
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
sourceTitle: Rheem (-)96V series installation instructions 92-24161-124-03, Table 20 R96V fault codes. Read 2026-11-07
